primaryTextRead.text: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.
The sons of Shem: Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, Aram, Uz, Hul, Gether, and Meshech.

wikipediaRead.locator: Lead lines 131–134: lines 132 names Meshech as Japheth’s son and cites 1CH1:5; line 134 separately identifies another Meshech as Shem’s son in 1CH1:17.
wikipediaRead.supportSummaryJa: 記事本文はヤペテの子メシェクと、セムの子として記される別の同名者を分けて記す。
wikipediaRead.identityAssessmentJa: 1CH1:5 and 1:17 have different parent lines; the article confirms the namesake distinction.
wikipediaRead.title: Meshech
